name: strict-scope-code-analysis
description: Precision AST, LSP, symbol, and static analysis tools for reading only Target Scope without repo-wide noise.

tools.name: LSP (typescript-language-server / Pyright / gopls / rust-analyzer / jdtls / clangd)
tools.role: Symbol definitions, hover types, references, and diagnostics

tools.name: ast-grep
tools.role: Structural AST pattern search and targeted rewrite

tools.name: Semgrep
tools.role: Rule-based AST bug and anti-pattern analysis

tools.name: CodeQL
tools.role: Semantic code query and dataflow analysis

tools.name: SonarQube
tools.role: Code smells, complexity, and maintainability gates

tools.name: Git CLI / GitHub MCP / gh / glab
tools.role: Diff verification and scope containment audit
